name: Garrucha (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided light blue over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Garrucha (a rising sun over the sea, a tower and a cross of Santiago, with the motto EX MARI ORTA).
history: Municipal flag of Garrucha; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Garrucha arms — sun over the sea, tower and cross with motto EX MARI ORTA
